name: SSL Pinning
summary: Adversaries may use SSL Pinning to protect the C2 traffic from being intercepted and analyzed. SSL Pinning is a technique commonly utilized by legitimate websites to ensure that encrypted communications are only allowed with a pre-defined certificate.
